dialogues.speaker: Ororon
dialogues.text: This domain is constantly changing, and the danger constantly evolving.. So I have something for you.

dialogues.speaker: Ororon
dialogues.text: This is what we call the "three warnings." Be wary of beasts prowling around, scammers looking for their next victim, and strange people who appear out of nowhere.

dialogues.speaker: Ororon
dialogues.text: You'd best learn that by heart — it might come in handy someday.
